title: Mondelēz International (MDLZ): Post-Cocoa Inflection — Wait for $63.35–$64.50 Support

destinations.entry_condition: Do not allocate until HSY reclaims Stage 2 above its 30W SMA ($177.01) with confirmed volume.

primer: Mondelēz International (NASDAQ: MDLZ) is an $83.90B global snacking leader. It generated $38.54B in FY2025 revenue across Biscuits (Oreo, Ritz, Clif Bar) and Chocolate (Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone). Q3 2026 delivered a clear operational inflection (+1.8 pp vol/mix, +380 bps adjusted gross margin). However, at $66.28 (19.76x Forward P/E), a grounded $71.50 Base Target (21.0x $3.40 FY27E EPS) offers only 1.08:1 R:R against our $61.43 stop amid 6 distribution days and a US Downtrend. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT ($63.35–$64.50) for 2.28:1 pullback asymmetry.
